barriers: No material barrier: the paper states "All data and R scripts are available on https://github.com/ercrema/diffusionCurve and permanently archived on https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.10782942" (p. 7), so the three case-study compilations, the three simulated datasets, the Japanese and British source compilations as redistributed, and the IntCal20 curve are Tier 0.

Residual caveat (non-blocking): assessed individually, three upstream sources of the case study 2 burial compilation would be Tier 2-3 - Bloxam (2020) UCL doctoral thesis, Wilkin (2013) University of Birmingham thesis, and Healy (2012) monograph chapter - but the dates extracted from them are redistributed within the deposited compilation, so they impose no retrieval barrier on reproduction.
The evidence pack carries no file listing for the GitHub or Zenodo records, so deposit contents rest on the paper's rung-(i) availability statement rather than an enumerated manifest.
